description_en: Triggers an online chat flow that has a manual trigger
description_zh: 触发已上线且触发器类型为手动的流程版本
name: TriggerChatFlow

parameters.help_en: The code of the flow. View the flow code on the Flow Editor (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page
parameters.help_zh: 流程编码。在流程编辑器 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面查看流程编码
parameters.name: flow_code

parameters.help_en: The input parameters in a key-value format. The keys must match the input parameter policy configured in the start node of the flow. To view the variable names in the start node, go to the Flow Editor (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder), click the name of the flow, and open the orchestration canvas
parameters.help_zh: 入参，Key-Value格式，其Key需要与您在流程开始节点配置的入参策略相匹配。在流程编辑器 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击触发器类型为手动的流程名称进入画布编排界面查看开始节点的变量名称
parameters.name: data

parameters.help_en: A custom unique ID for the event, used to ensure idempotence. Do not include business semantics in the ID. After the flow is triggered, you can retrieve this parameter from within the flow
parameters.help_zh: 自定义事件唯一ID，用于触发幂等，请勿携带任何业务语义，触发后您可以在流程中获取到此参数
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en: A custom serial number from an external system. Use this parameter to associate the trigger with an external business process. After the flow is triggered, you can retrieve this parameter from within the flow
parameters.help_zh: 自定义外部系统流水号，用于关联外部业务系统流水，触发后您可以在流程中获取到此参数
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en: The time when the event occurs. This is when the flow is triggered and is typically the time when the request is created. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 声明事件发生时刻，即为流程触发时刻，一般为请求构造时刻，时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: claim_time_millis

parameters.help_en: The time when the event expires. If you specify this parameter, the trigger is canceled if the request is not processed before this time. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 声明事件被丢弃时刻，即为触发流程的过期时刻，若声明了该字段，发起请求后响应时间超过此时刻，流程触发将被取消，时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: discard_time_millis

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: Details about the access denied error

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
